measurement: Use actual generated visual geometry, and keep original natural PCM and j/25 output clock. Height/aperture only is the primary semantic response; width and speed are descriptive collateral. No human accuracy claim.

support.membership: Keep original natural MFA exact high[a]/low[i,y,u], 20-80% cores and original S17 central timestamps for the selected clips. Require all17 new j+lag samples valid for all3arms and within original duration; any loss explicitly reported, no token replacement or support tuning.
support.minimum: Per clip/model require at least one high and one low supported token, each with >=2 shared central timestamps. If unmet, functional endpoint UNMEASURABLE; do not expand cohort.

phase.rule: Reuse previous canonical RMS-only officialoffset median across its3seeds per model/clip, identically for zero/plus/minus; read visual_j+p against natural audio phone at j; do not select new peaks or move output clock.
phase.new_zero_phase: Report newzero officialoffset vs oldRMS descriptively; if the frozen-phase control fails, classify that model response unresolved rather than retuning p.

normalization: Per row mean/population SD from original-duration, tracking-valid timestamp intersection across the new3arms; keep raw measurements too. Zero and candidates each retain their own mean/SD on the identical mask. No pooling frame observations as independent speakers.
aggregation: Mean central frames per token -> equal tokens per exact base phone -> equal base phones per high/low class -> high-minus-low contrast per clip/model/arm. Cp=C(p). Hp=C(p)-mean(C(p-4),C(p+4)); compute within clip before speaker reduction. Report all17points descriptively, no peak-selected primary.

response_screen.unit: One clip/person, paired signs within each model; n2 is screening, no p-value, confidence or efficacy confirmation.
response_screen.zero_functional_control: Each model must have positive raw and z Cp and Hp at the frozen p for bothclips to support an interpretable positive class response.
response_screen.primary_prediction: For bothclips in a model, raw and z Cp_plus>Cp_zero>Cp_minus and Hp_plus>Hp_zero>Hp_minus. Strict signs use zero numerical tolerance 1e-9 for reported endpoint comparisons; show the actual deltas including near-zero values.
response_screen.cross_model_progression: Only if all3 models pass the above bounded response criterion may a new separately budgeted waveform reachability hypothesis be proposed. Mixed results stop expansion of this direction/dose and inform a distinct coordinate hypothesis; never enlarge cohort or flip sign posthoc.

score_endpoints: Canonical original-clock full/guard20 float32 raw matrices, Cbest=B-Dmin, B,Dmin,D0, officialoffset for all18; +/- minus same-route zero. Score changes and mouth response are separate results. No score tuning, shifted mux, candidate-audio scoring or reuse of oldRMS as the causalzero.
limits: Nativehook edits preserve per-frame norm and intratoken Gram, but core-boundary transitions and other semantic projections may change. Wav normalizer excursions are descriptive and no clipping is allowed. A controllable native output direction is not a physically reachable waveform head.
